source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'The Internet (Public WAN)' (PDF 8-9): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Internet poori duniya ka network hai jo millions (laakhon) devices ko jorta hai. Is se poori duniya mein maloomat share hoti hain. Email, websites aur cloud storage (internet par files rakhne ki jagah) jaisi services Internet istemal karti hain (jaise Figure 1.5 mein). Internet baat-cheet ke liye standard protocols (sab ke maane hue qaide) istemal karta hai. Internet education (taleem), business aur entertainment (tafreeh) mein madad deta hai. Rozana zindagi mein is ka bara kirdar hai.

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein globe (duniya ka gola), jo lakeeron se charon taraf ke devices se jura hai: do desktop computers, laptop, router, printer, server aur Wi-Fi ke nishan wale kai badal; kuch devices aapas mein bhi jure hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.5: Internet (kitab ki Figure 1.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba un services ki fehrist banayein jo Internet istemal karti hain. Internet ki ahmiyat par baat karein.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text:
• DSL (Digital Subscriber Line): telephone lines ke zariye Internet; is mein ek hi waqt mein call aur browsing dono ho sakti hain.
• ISP (Internet Service Provider): woh company jo logon ko Internet deti hai.

blocks.prompt: Internet ko "Public WAN" kyun kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh duniya bhar mein phaila hua sab se bara WAN hai jise har koi (public) istemal kar sakta hai.
Internet Service Provider: woh company jo users ko Internet deti hai.

items: Internet: poori duniya ka public network; email, websites, cloud storage; standard protocols.
DSL: telephone line par Internet, call aur browsing ek saath; ISP: Internet dene wali company.
